title.zh: 机制设计与拍卖 · 报价如何改变结果
title.en: Mechanism Design & Auctions · How Bids Change Outcomes

description.zh: 机制是给博弈定规则：同一群人、同一件物品，换一条成交规则，报价与结果全变。第一价收最高报价，第二价收第二高报价——后者让说真话不再吃亏。
description.en: A mechanism sets the rules for a game: same people, same item, a different settlement rule, and bids and outcome all change. First-price takes the top bid, second-price takes the runner-up — and the latter makes truth-telling cost nothing.

label.zh: 拍卖是机制的一个实例
label.en: An auction is one instance of a mechanism

reason.zh: 拍卖页讲出价与成交，机制页追问规则本身：同一群人、同一件物品，换一条成交规则，报价与结果全变。
reason.en: The auction page covers bids and sales; the mechanism page asks about the rule itself: same people, same item, a different settlement rule, and bids and outcome all change.

label.zh: 报价行为要用博弈来读
label.en: Bidding behavior reads as a game

reason.zh: 每个竞标者都按私人价值算计着报，机制设计就是给这场算计定规则——报价不是随手写的数，是博弈里的策略。
reason.en: Every bidder calculates from private value, so mechanism design is rule-setting for that calculation — a bid is not a number written casually, it is a strategy in a game.

label.zh: 第二价让说真话不再吃亏

reason.zh: 第一价里人人压价藏真实价值，像囚徒困境里各自算计；第二价收第二高报价，说真话不再吃亏，规则改写了博弈的 payoff。
reason.en: Under first-price everyone shades their true value, calculating like prisoners in a dilemma; second-price charges the runner-up bid, so truth-telling stops costing anything — the rule rewrites the game's payoff.
